name: Dare mo Shiranai Sora e no Namida
original_name: 誰も知らない天体への涙
source:
Tendou Haruka looked up to the sky and made his two wishes.

First, he wanted to know the truth.
And second, he wanted someone back.

Luna, ruler of Eclipse, was the only being powerful enough to grant his grief-filled plea.
But first, with his soul hanging in the balance, he had to complete the Oracles she demanded of him.

This is the tale of the war between Haruka and Luna.
The tale of Haruka's solitary war.

No one will know the tears he sheds.

[Edited from [url=https://solpress.co/product/336/daresora-tears-for-an-unknown-sky]Sol Press[/url]]

[url=/p7745]Anagram[/url] announced the cancellation of DareSora on 21st May 2021 alongside their dissolution. However, development was again resumed in June with the help of NEKO WORKs. The original writer Sakuraba Maruo also replaced Ryouchin as the new director of the project.
